note: Plan 0031, D4 (step 1): what the web pack leaves out, and the JSON that it has as gzip copies. tools/web/prepare.py writes the filters of the preset Web of export_presets.cfg from this file and makes the copies before the export (tools/web/deploy.sh); tools/web/check_pack.py checks the pack after it (R2), and tests/unit/test_web_pack.gd checks the preset. The desktop builds keep one whole pack.
buildings_note: The buildings of World: the web pack has no near level of them, and on the web their mid level shows also from near, on each preset (plan 0031, Q2; WorldModel.levels_of()). A building is a model with a place in data/world/places/, a model of the blueprint building, or a tube house of plan 0009.
left_out_note: Files that the game does not read: the raw data of the geodata pipeline, and the files of the build for the reports and the tools.
gzip_note: The JSON of the build that the game reads goes in the web pack as PATH.gz (GeoData.read_text()).
